Changelog

Unreleased — 2026-10-24

  • Let sliders reserve modified arrow keys for the person's bindings.
  • Give the New macro title field the drop-down's measured width, anchored placement and a full text-field height. Wrap inline errors within that frame.
  • Cover title entry at scale 2.5, including wider catalogues and a snapshot.
  • Share atomic-save target resolution with the editor and probe that exact directory, including through symlinks. Refuse read-only macro files inline.
  • Keep tall macro menus below their icon and scroll vertically; reserve the themed scrollbar gutter without adding an unnecessary horizontal scrollbar.
  • Pin the empty menu's final row after separator cleanup.

Unreleased — 2026-10-23

  • Give icon-anchored menus the menu bar's minimum width and frame metrics; right-align at the icon near window edges and constrain oversized content.

  • Explain empty macro catalogues with a disabled row.

  • Keep failed macro creates and copies in the menu with path-specific errors. Check existing files' save directories before editing and retain dirty edits with path-specific save errors if permissions later change.

  • Focus the macro title only after its visible widget is drawn, and release focus before disabling it for creation, keeping AccessKit focus valid.

  • Save macro editor snapshots independently of discovery, keep the document visible during writes, and save dirty edits before closing the editor.

  • Wake idle macro windows only for live work or native Bus deliveries.

  • Invalidate cached picks on catalogue changes and take title-field keys before app content; match menu-bar outside-click dismissal.

  • Withdraw notifications on window close and prioritise live run output.

  • Cover menu/app synchronisation and runner teardown with hermetic fixtures.

  • Use one lazy native Bus client and notify.changed subscription per process, with bounded output retention and repaint-driven deliveries.

  • Dim macro rows during a run; Ctrl+Enter still saves and reports an active run.

  • Keep the title field and show an inline error when creating a macro fails.

  • Scope macro state, widget IDs and anchored-menu input to each viewport, releasing notification output when a viewport closes.

  • Replace the modal Macros panel with an icon-anchored menu, title-only creation and a non-modal shared editor with save/run shortcuts.

  • Report completed macros through notifyd, retaining output per notification and opening the output strip if notifications are unavailable.

  • Reuse menu navigation and drawing for anchored menus, including secondary release, Shift+Enter editing and title-initial navigation.

  • Accept the shared editor's palette role interface without a dependency cycle.

Unreleased — 2026-10-21

  • Publish command contract 0.2.0 executed bodies (v2, bounded params and result).
  • Map authorisation refusals to legacy CommandError::Denied.
  • Report stored shortcut and more chords in the keymaps grammar, with Ctrl, Alt, Shift modifier order, through both command adapters.
